correctness.rationale: For a finite subgroup H the character idempotents have norm one, decompose all of ℓ¹(G), and annihilate cross-products. The exact construction factors every arbitrarily supported nearby target with factor errors < ε using at most ε/(2|H|) per coordinate. A norm-one extension of a subgroup character gives matching ε^s obstruction. Proof treats zero/nonzero Fourier coordinates, empty products, k≥2 and independence of finite H; exact finite checker 201 assertions is corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete sharp local openness classification on the dense finite-support class of precisely the remaining infinite abelian torsion group algebras in Flores 2026, valid for arbitrary infinite-support targets. The simultaneous-zero multiplicity provides a natural structural invariant and shows any global obstruction must arise from an infinite-support input. This is stronger than finite-dimensional coordinate computation and useful in the still-open group class.
